# Shukoi Framework (@shukoi/*)

> Enterprise-grade, ultra-fast, transport-agnostic TypeScript micro-framework. Write business logic once in defineAction() and automatically expose REST APIs, OpenAPI 3.1, MCP HTTP, and MCP STDIO across Cloudflare Workers, AWS Lambda, and Self-Host (Bun/Node).

## Core Architecture & Guidelines
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Authoritative repository constitution, Twelve Architectural Laws, and coding standards.
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Deep architectural specification, 8-step execution pipeline, cancellation, and backpressure.
- [README.md](README.md): Developer quickstart, package matrix, and installation guide.

## Architecture Decision Records (ADRs)
- [ADR 001: Adaptive TypeBox JIT](docs/adr/001-adaptive-typebox-jit.md): JIT compilation in Node/Bun with AST fallback on Cloudflare Workers isolates.
- [ADR 002: Per-Request Scoped MCP Server](docs/adr/002-per-request-mcp-server.md): Eliminating singleton _transport race conditions under concurrent HTTP calls.
- [ADR 003: Single-Flight JWKS Discovery](docs/adr/003-single-flight-jwks-discovery.md): Mutex coalescing concurrent cache-miss fetches into 1 network call.
- [ADR 004: Stream-Bounded Body Parsing](docs/adr/004-stream-bounded-body-parsing.md): Chunk byte counter aborting at maxBodyBytes preventing chunked OOM attacks.
- [ADR 005: Sterile stdout and Anti-Zombie Watchdog](docs/adr/005-sterile-stdout-and-anti-zombie.md): Reserving FD 1 for JSON-RPC frames and terminating on stdin pipe closure.

## Agent Skills
- [Skill: Create Action](skills/shukoi-create-action/SKILL.md): Step-by-step procedural guide for creating protocol-agnostic 1-file actions.
- [Skill: Deploy Target](skills/shukoi-deploy-target/SKILL.md): Adapting Shukoi apps to Cloudflare Workers, AWS Lambda, and Bun/Node self-host.
- [Skill: Quality Gates](skills/shukoi-quality-gates/SKILL.md): Authoring and verifying mandatory CI Quality Gates QG-01 through QG-07.
- [Skill: Distributed Resilience](skills/shukoi-distributed-resilience/SKILL.md): Redis Idempotency Store, atomic Lua scripts, and distributed rate limiting (Sliding Window & Token Bucket).
- [Skill: OTel Observability](skills/shukoi-otel-observability/SKILL.md): OpenTelemetry W3C distributed tracing, OTLP 1.34+ export, and Prometheus metrics exposition.
- [Skill: Auth & RBAC](skills/shukoi-auth-rbac/SKILL.md): Multi-strategy identity resolution (JWKS, API Key, Session Cookie, OIDC) and declarative RBAC/ABAC guards.
- [Skill: Database Transactions](skills/shukoi-database-transactions/SKILL.md): Pluggable ORM transaction adapters (Drizzle, Kysely, Prisma, D1) and Transactional Outbox pattern.

## Scoped Packages
- [@shukoi/core](packages/core/AGENTS.md): Action engine, adaptive validator, single-flight auth, sterile logger, and testing harness.
- [@shukoi/api](packages/api/AGENTS.md): Hono REST router, stream-bounded reader, OpenAPI 3.1 generator (query params, security schemes), and universal RFC 9457 Problem Details (with 404 handler).
- [@shukoi/mcp](packages/mcp/AGENTS.md): Streamable HTTP (DNS-rebinding protected, DELETE 204) and sterile STDIO (FIFO queue, backpressure drain) MCP server for tools, resources (URI templates), and prompts.
- [@shukoi/cloudflare](packages/cloudflare/AGENTS.md): Cloudflare Workers V8 Isolate adapter with getCloudflareContext, waitUntil, and in-memory D1/KV mocks (./testing).
- [@shukoi/lambda](packages/lambda/AGENTS.md): AWS Lambda adapter with getLambdaContext, dynamic deadline calculation, cookies, binary Base64, and in-memory event mocks (./testing).
- [@shukoi/selfhost](packages/selfhost/AGENTS.md): Bun and Node server with getSelfHostContext, OOM 413 defense, graceful drain, /healthz probes, and in-memory mocks (./testing).
- [@shukoi/store-redis](packages/store-redis/AGENTS.md): Distributed Redis idempotency store with atomic Lua scripts (ACQUIRE, COMPLETE, RELEASE, EXTEND), wrapRedisClient multi-driver adapter, extendLock heartbeat, dual runtimes (./node and ./edge), and in-memory mocks (./testing).
- [@shukoi/ratelimit](packages/ratelimit/AGENTS.md): Universal distributed rate limiter (Sliding Window and Token Bucket) with Redis Hash Lua engine, BoundedLruCache memory protection, IETF Draft-08 headers, and in-memory mocks (./testing).
- [@shukoi/otel](packages/otel/AGENTS.md): Enterprise OpenTelemetry distributed tracing and Prometheus metrics plugin with OTLP 1.34+ service metadata, SpanKind, exception recording, bounded queue ceiling, and in-memory mocks (./testing).
- [@shukoi/auth](packages/auth/AGENTS.md): Enterprise multi-strategy identity (cached JWKS, O(1) pre-hashed API keys, Session Cookie, bounded OIDC) and declarative RBAC/ABAC guards with in-memory mocks (./testing).
- [@shukoi/db](packages/db/AGENTS.md): Universal modular database and transaction engine with pluggable ORM adapters (Drizzle, Kysely, Prisma, D1), ANSI SQL isolation levels, native D1 batch(), auto-rollback, and Transactional Outbox.
- [create-shukoi](packages/create-shukoi/AGENTS.md): Interactive and CI project scaffolder CLI.
